_comment: Plugins students can install from the admin page (and mc-plugins.sh).
variants: key = lowest Minecraft version the jar is for ('*' = all versions).
For a server on version V the variant with the highest key <= V is used.
Values are download URLs, or file:<name> for a jar in spigot/ (build context).
default: installed automatically on a fresh server.
locked:  always installed, cannot be removed by students.
requires: ids installed together with this plugin.
replaces: file globs of older/foreign copies removed when this plugin is installed.
All jars are downloaded when the image is built, so servers need no internet.

plugins.name: script4kids
plugins.description: JavaScript-Programme schreiben, die in Minecraft bauen (/runscript).

plugins.name: CaveCompass
plugins.description: Ein Kompass, der zur nächsten Höhle oder zu Blöcken wie Bienennestern zeigt.

plugins.name: geomaptools
plugins.description: Echte Karten (OpenStreetMap) und Bilder in die Welt holen und schnell bauen.

plugins.name: ViaVersion
plugins.description: Spieler mit einer neueren Minecraft-Version dürfen auf den Server.

plugins.name: ViaBackwards
plugins.description: Spieler mit einer älteren Minecraft-Version dürfen auf den Server (braucht ViaVersion).

plugins.name: PrometheusExporter
plugins.description: Liefert Messwerte für das Monitoring (Grafana). Pflicht-Plugin.
